data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: Create crates/kate-syntax/definitions/dotenv.xml by copying data/syntax/dotenv.xml from KSyntaxHighlighting commit 6d8ab7945958e7354295db7f399cce06f7de7571. Copy the whole file. Do not add a copyright comment. Do not remove an upstream comment. The SPDX license identifier stays in the file. The language name is DotEnv. The license attribute is MIT. Do not change the license attribute. Do not add a second syntax file. Do not edit repository.rs. Do not add an include_str line. Do not edit SOURCES.md. Do not edit the six files that are already vendored. Do not edit abnf.xml, adblock.xml, ahdl.xml, antlr.xml, asm-arm.xml, brightscript.xml, cabal.xml, or capnproto.xml. A reference to ##Comments stays in the file. comments.xml is already vendored. This packet adds no Rust test. cargo test -p kate-syntax --locked repository::tests::six_vendored_definitions_load_and_link stays green. Do not rewrite that test. Branch from the current tip of main. base_sha records that tip at planning time. If main has moved, use the new tip. Start this copy after PKT-0028 is on main. PKT-0251 through PKT-0258 are already on main. Do not edit cashscript.xml, changelog.xml, cil.xml, clist.xml, cobol.xml, coffee.xml, commonlisp.xml, or csv-pipe.xml.
